correctness.rationale: Each feasible output is uniquely a bounded zero-sum difference vector. Pairwise indicator products give exact second moment via coordinatewise maxima and stars-and-bars. Single-deficiency strata each have leading frequency q(q-1)/n; multiple deficiency has probability O(n^-2). Explicit ternary classes exhaust all patterns for n>=6, with one overlap for two zero coordinates. The standalone direct-distance checker independently passed 4,451 centers and ternary rational moment tests at n=6..40.

value.rationale: The motivating source identifies nonhomogeneity of multiset metric-ball volumes as a concrete obstacle to coding volume arguments. This result resolves a quantitative missing layer (full second moment, rare-boundary dispersion and conditional defect classification) and gives the entire all-length spectrum in the natural ternary radius-two case, supplying exact finite-size benchmarks beyond extremal and mean values.
